ShortMetadata.CurrentLayoutSchema: raft8/v3: ToIndex prefixes 1=meta,2=log,3=config; RF3M packed state/frontier; checked v2 entries
ShortMetadata.CurrentCacheReadPolicy: published entries readable during unrelated flush; atomic short-gate publication
ShortMetadata.CurrentProposalCollector: bounded change signal; owner drains admitted commands without waiting
ShortMetadata.CurrentFollowerAppendGrouping: already-queued plain same-term tail extensions; original per-frame replies after one bounded durable write
ShortMetadata.CurrentCommitNotificationPolicy: ordinary idle commit notifications piggyback next data/heartbeat; read/config/transfer immediate
ShortMetadata.CurrentProposalFlushPolicy: off-owner in-flight feedback deadline; bounded 2ms count-limited,8ms byte-limited with other admitted work,1ms single-voter collection
ShortMetadata.Storage: Raft.Net: disk DBreeze log+application/engine/node. DotNext: native persistent WAL AutoFlush+IntegrityCheck, DBreeze application/engine/node.
ShortMetadata.Application: same ComparisonMachine: payload ring256,count,CRC(index,term) atomic; validate all replicas + close/reopen every successful round
ShortMetadata.Batch: count128, all application256KiB(21B accounting); Current wire1MiB+2688B metadata headroom, baseline wire256KiB, native DotNext wire aggregation has its own limits; Current durable proposal group default4x256KiB+128x21B metadata headroom (1051264 encoded bytes, bounded), override via --proposal-batch-bytes; baseline/DotNext proposal256KiB; Current off-owner collection up to2ms small,8ms byte-limited with other admitted work,1ms single-voter; Current followers coalesce only already-queued fresh plain contiguous frames within the local budget, preserving individual replies and configured wire bounds; DotNext1ms; baseline drains queued
ShortMetadata.Order: one cluster at a time; round outermost, topology/payload groups, rotate case order by round
